keep.text: Aaj ke time pe mera body fat 15.5 - 15.6% body fat hai.
aaj main aap logon ko bata raha hoon ki ye saari cheezein maine
water fasting, intermittent fasting, achhi diet, achhi exercise, khoob saara workout, in saari cheezon se kar diya hai.
Aap bhi kar sakte ho, bahut zyada tough cheez nahi hai.
Agar aapne yahan soch liya hai toh aap kar loge. Agar aapka mindset kharab hai toh aap nahi kar paoge. Aur mindset banane ke liye chahiye hota hai ek protocol.
Toh wo protocol maine aap logon ke liye bana diya hai,
aur wo saari cheezein main discuss karunga is webinar mein. Aap logon ko
turant join karna chahiye. Webinar link neeche hai, join karein, webinar, milte hain webinar mein!
